animation: Every 20 ms the chip sends a new set of 72 measured bits, and many positions change from one frame to the next.
highlight: the set of bits that changed since the previous frame
rebaselineReason: The converted module is held to STYLE.md (check-copy): the title line above the grid loses its em dash. The byte labels are right-aligned to the cells, so on a phone the label no longer runs under the first cell (the 3D view's tiles would hide it). The changed bits are outlined in --ambe-highlight, as in the 3D view and the poster, not in --ambe-accent-warm, and the outline stays at full strength on a held frame.
